program.name: Fighter Volume
program.subject: Fighter
program.blurb: Three fighter days: boxing and upper strength, kickboxing and legs, then bouts and a power circuit.
program.about: A fighter's week in three days. Boxing bouts lead into presses and rows; kickboxing bouts into squats, hinges and lunges; and mixed bouts into a circuit of power lifts. Every session ends with abs. Level II adds reps and Level III moves you one weight up.
program.split: Boxing & upper strength / kickboxing & legs / bouts & power circuit
